notes.title: Japanese Language Support Added!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8181840/8e5c241bd9e6943576ad8573c506982dca986884.png[/img]
With the gracious permission of the developer [b]Tazigen Clock[/b], we're happy to report that [b]ManaCollect[/b] on Steam has now been updated to include the original Japanese language as well!

Please enjoy!

notes.title: ManaCollect Now on Steam!
notes.notes:
[img]https://fruitbatfactory.files.wordpress.com/2015/04/manacollect-ss-03.png[/img]
ManaCollect has finally landed on Steam! Prepare to battle a motley crew of characters over hidden mana in this competitive Minesweeper-esque action puzzle game.

Features: 
-4-chapter single player storyline 
-10 playable characters 
-4 difficulty settings 
-2-Player Local multiplayer 
-Dungeon and Tournament modes

ManaCollect comes with Steam Trading Cards, Achievements, and full controller support. English release includes an all-new HD mode.

ManaCollect is now available for purchase, with a -10% launch discount for a week!

notes.title: ManaCollect Comes in HD!
notes.notes:
[img]https://fruitbatfactory.files.wordpress.com/2015/04/manacollect-ss-02.png[/img]
We're happy to announce that ManaCollect will be hitting Steam with HD support.

The English release will include an all-new 720p Widescreen mode, as well as support for anti-aliasing and texture filtering. 

We hope you'll enjoy the new, improved graphics as you collect your way to victory!

A new set of widescreen screenshots can be seen on the ManaCollect store page.
